Starbucks vs Dunkin Iced Cup Sizes: A PET Sourcing Guide

Article Quick Facts

Starbucks Range
12 oz (Tall) to 31 oz (Trenta)
Dunkin Range
16 oz (Small) to 32 oz (Large)
Standard Caliber
98 mm (US Market Default)
Jumbo Caliber
107 mm (Trenta / XL size)

Why Coffee Shop Iced Sizes Differ from Boba

In the North American coffee market, iced beverages are dominated by the 98mm caliber PET cup. Unlike the 95mm standard common in Asian boba shops, the 98mm width provides a wider profile that accommodates larger amounts of ice and fits universal US cup holders. Understanding how giants like Starbucks and Dunkin size their drinks is key to choosing your own inventory.

Starbucks Iced Cup Sizes (oz to ml)

Starbucks uses unique names for its volumes. If you want to offer a "Trenta" equivalent, you need our 107mm jumbo series.

NameozmlSourcing Equivalent
Tall12 oz355 ml98-12oz (98mm)
Grande16 oz473 ml98-16oz (98mm)
Venti24 oz709 ml98-24oz (98mm)
Trenta31 oz916 ml107-10701 (32oz)

Dunkin Iced Cup Sizes (oz to ml)

Dunkin sizes are typically larger than Starbucks at the "Small" and "Medium" tiers, favoring high-volume iced coffee drinkers.

NameozmlSourcing Equivalent
Small16 oz473 ml98-16oz (98mm)
Medium24 oz709 ml98-24oz (98mm)
Large32 oz946 ml107-10701 (32oz)

Choosing the Right Caliber for Coffee

If you are targeting the US or European coffee market, we recommend standardizing on the 98mm PET caliber. This allows you to use one lid size across 12oz, 16oz, and 24oz cups, significantly reducing storage needs. For premium "Trenta" or 32oz sharing sizes, the 107mm caliber (Model 107-10701) provides the necessary structural rigidity for heavy, ice-filled drinks.

Article FAQs

What is the most popular iced coffee size?

The 16oz (Grande/Medium) is the global standard, followed by the 24oz for iced lattes and cold brews.

Does Claropack offer "Trenta" size cups?

Yes. Our 32oz PET cup (Model 107-10701) is the industry standard for XL promotional and sharing drinks.

Can I use one lid for all coffee sizes?

Yes, if you use the 98mm series. It covers 12oz, 16oz, 20oz, and 24oz PET cups with a single 98mm flat or dome lid.
